ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which section of the Japanese Beetle covers its wings?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a body diagram of a Japanese beetle, with the front part of the body being a green head and thorax, and a large brown, hard covering structure with longitudinal ridges on the back/rear part, located above the position where the wings are folded. Reasoning: The question asks which segment of the Japanese beetle covers its wings. According to insect body structure, the main body segment at the rear is the abdomen; the position of the brown covering over the wings in the figure is on the back, above the abdominal region. Therefore the answer is the abdomen.
